requirements: Users belong to tenants (memberships). A user may read a document of a tenant they belong to if the document's level is at most their clearance; tenant admins may read every document of their tenants. Members may create documents in their tenants at a level within their clearance, and may update any document of their tenants as long as the updated document's level is within their clearance. A document is archived unless its archived column holds a value other than 1 (a missing value counts as archived); archived documents are hidden from everyone: nobody can read, create, change or delete them. Levels are 0..3. A document's owner, if set, must be a member of the document's tenant; admins must be members.
expected_properties: A user only sees, creates or updates documents of tenants they belong to.
Removing a membership never grants anyone access.
Levels stay in range; owners and admins stay members of their tenants.
Whatever a user writes, they can read back.
The application role has no privilege beyond select/insert/update on docs and reading memberships.
